service.name: egpt
service.description: DeSciX SSG Podcast Server for the egpt app — RSS 2.0 / iTunes podcast publishing (control plane). Manages episode state in Firestore and publishes a static feed to GCS that Apple Podcasts polls.

podcast_create_show.description: Create or update a podcast show's channel-level metadata. Validates required Apple channel fields.

show.description: Show slug (URL-safe identifier, unique per app)

podcast_publish_episode.description: Publish a podcast episode and republish the show's feed.xml. TWO PATHS keyed off the audio input: (1) MP3 FAST PATH — when `audio` is an already-encoded .mp3 (by extension) OR `mp3:true` is set, the file is used AS-IS: no transcode, no loudness normalization, no ID3 re-embed, no re-upload. The mp3 MUST already be a gs:// or https:// ref (upload it first with `descix app media-upload`); enclosure byte-length and duration are read from the object/probe (or taken from `enclosureLength`/`duration` if provided). This path stays synchronous and fast so it never exceeds the ~60s edge request timeout. (2) SLOW PATH — any non-mp3 input (e.g. m4a, or a local file) is streamed to disk, loudness-normalized to -16 LUFS, ID3-tagged (artwork + chapters), transcoded to mp3, and uploaded as the canonical enclosure. Both paths append episode state to Firestore (source of truth) and regenerate + upload feed.xml. Returns { episode_url, enclosure_length, duration_seconds, fast_path (boolean), feed_url, guid }.

audio.description: Episode audio source. MP3 FAST PATH: a gs:// or https:// ref to an already-encoded .mp3 (preferred; upload via `descix app media-upload`) — used as-is. SLOW PATH: any other format (m4a) or a local dev path — transcoded + normalized to mp3.

imagePath.description: Local path to episode cover art for ID3 artwork embed. SLOW PATH only (the fast path does not re-tag). Alias: image_path.

contentEncoded.description: Rich HTML show notes for content:encoded; defaults to description

mp3.description: Force the MP3 fast path even if `audio` lacks a .mp3 extension (audio must still be a gs:///https:// mp3 ref). Default: inferred from the .mp3 extension.

enclosureLength.description: MP3 fast path only: enclosure byte length. If omitted, read via a HEAD on the gs:///https:// object.

duration.description: MP3 fast path only: episode duration in seconds. If omitted, probed from the audio.

podcast_unpublish_episode.description: Remove an episode's state and regenerate the feed.

podcast_list_episodes.description: Return episodes (newest first) and the live feed URL for a show.

podcast_regenerate_feed.description: Idempotent rebuild + republish of feed.xml from Firestore episode state.

podcast_validate_feed.description: Validate the generated feed against Apple Podcasts requirements; returns pass/fail + specific violations.

imageWidth.description: Cover art width px (enables square 1400-3000 check)
